sasha: Quick summary from today's attention kernel sweep across A100 / H100 / L40S. Ran seq sweep (128,256,512,1024,2048,4096) x bsz (1,4,8,16). Fused-paged variant wins up to 1024. On H100 we see a surprising 18-25% regression at seq>=2048 for fused path. Raw numbers + short notes below.

bench-bot: CI run 2026-03-17T14:05Z - job/attn-sweep-3162839456
```
# device seq bsz ms_per_token variant notes
A100 1024 8 0.48 fused-paged
H100 1024 8 0.42 fused-paged
L40S 1024 8 0.55 fused-paged
A100 2048 8 0.86 fused-paged
H100 2048 8 1.06 fused-paged  # regression vs expected ~0.85
L40S 2048 8 0.88 paged-flash
A100 4096 4 1.55 paged-flash
H100 4096 4 1.82 paged-flash but higher memcopy wait
```

lee: Did you capture NVTX / timeline traces for the H100 run? Looks like a memcpy hotspot might explain the gap.

sasha: Yes - NVTX shows repeated host->device memcpy bursts right after KV-cache spill for fused path. Timeline snippet: `memcpy H2D 120ms` cycles every generation window. Not present on L40S runs.

maya: Does the H100 nodes we used have PLX/PCIe topology difference? Could be a fallback to PCIe DMA for certain driver configs. Which AMI/kernel?

sasha: H100 image: rdx-h100-2026-02-10, CUDA 12.2, driver 535.48.10. L40S image: rdx-l40s-2026-01-21. Verified same model binary. The memcpy appears when KV cache size crosses ~8GB (seq*bsz footprint).

raj: I uploaded a quick flamegraph: https://redwood-internal/fg/3162839456. Shows stalled thread in `copy_to_device` and then waiting on `cuMemcpyAsync`.

lee: Interesting. Could be scatter/gather fallback when the fused kernel uses batched memcpy for long KV. We should capture `cudaMemcpyKind` and stream activity. Also try the H100 with `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` to see ordering effects (brief test).

bench-bot: Added perf counters to the job and reran with `--trace-memcpy` flag. New run id: job/attn-sweep-3162839521. Logs: `memcopy-wait-ms` aggregated: H100@2048 bsz8 = 118ms (A100 = 22ms, L40S = 28ms).

sasha: Proposed mitigation: update kernel-selector heuristic to prefer paged-flash or fallback fused-path with `disable_async_prefetch` when estimated KV > 6GB on H100 until we sort driver/PCIe behavior. Also experiment with bumping batch threshold from 8 -> 12 to avoid frequent spills.

maya: Can we try enabling the `pinned_prefetch` flag (alloc pinned host buffers) on H100 to reduce H2D latency? If that reduces memcopy-wait we can add a targeted opt instead of switching kernels.

lee: I'll open a small PR: selector heuristic + runtime flags to toggle pinned_prefetch for H100. Will add perf regression test that runs H100@2048 bsz8 and asserts ms_per_token delta < 10% vs baseline. Assigning to me.

sasha: Thanks. Also adding a metric to Console: `memcopy_wait_ms` per-model/per-route so we can detect this across customers.

raj: FYI I repro'd locally on a lab H100 with driver 535.48.10. If we can repro across kernels we should file driver bug with vendor. I'll paste repro steps in the issue.

bench-bot: Created issue #412: "H100 fused-paged memcopy stall at large KV sizes" and linked runs. (https://redwood-internal/issue/412)

lee: I'll run the pinned_prefetch patch and report back with NVTX. If that helps we can ship a temporary hotfix in the runtime and add an env var guard.

sasha: Cool. Next actions: (1) lee opens PR for selector+flag, (2) maya tries pinned_prefetch A/B, (3) raj files driver repro, (4) add memcopy_wait_ms to Console dashboards. I'll rerun the sweep after PR lands and post updated bench-bot summary. :thumbsup:
